name: Full 90-second demo rehearsal (barge-in, escalation, correction, report)

turns.say: The refrigeration unit at our Yangon branch stopped cooling about twenty minutes ago. It's showing twelve degrees and we've got frozen chicken and dairy inside.
It's running, but it's not cooling. What should we do right now?
Wait, stop. I already moved the food to the bar fridge.
Actually, I checked again. It says thirteen point four degrees.
